acceptance: Agreed behavior (code or documented reading) so a waiting verdict is never misread as a refusal.
context: Found during the 2026-10-13 session: the waiting state was twice misread as a verdict refusal across PRs #2948 and #2915, delaying merges while the oracle was simply still working.
description: The oracle-review CI check exits failure while merely awaiting a verdict for the head, which reads identically to a refusal. Consider reporting pending/neutral until a verdict exists for the head, failing only on refusal, expiry, or SHIP-with-unresolved-threads; or document the reading so the next session does not chase a non-defect.
